input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) imposes a one-way non-solicit on us (Licensee only) that runs for the Term plus three years after expiration or termination and covers any person employed by Licensor or any of its Affiliates. That fails the fallback on two material terms: duration exceeds 24 months and the scope covers the entire Vendor workforce rather than personnel directly involved in the services — both expressly in walk-away territory. Points in our favour: the clause is solicitation-only (no "no-hire" or "employ or engage" restraint) and already contains the required carve-outs for general job advertising and unsolicited/voluntary employment inquiries, so those elements need no change. Consistent with the redline guidance, we narrowed to the fallback with minimal edits: mutuality, scope limited to personnel directly involved in the services, and a 12-month tail measured from the end of that involvement, leaving the existing carve-out sentence intact.

proposal.summary: Make the non-solicit mutual, limit it to personnel directly involved in the services and cut the tail from three years to twelve months from the end of that involvement.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the non-solicit mutual and narrowed it to personnel directly involved in the services, with the restriction running twelve months from the end of that involvement rather than three years after termination. Our playbook does not accept restraints exceeding 24 months or covering an entire counterparty workforce; the existing general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs are retained unchanged.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period following the end of an individual's involvement in the performance or receipt of services under this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party and/or its Affiliates who was directly involved in the performance or receipt of such services to leave his or her employment with that other party.
